memory_footprint.note: Parameter weights only; full-night BiGRU activation buffers and RTOS stack require separate SRAM budgeting.

data_and_context_protocol.dataset: PhysioNet BIDSleep (47 healthy adults, 246 usable nights; healthy-adult cohort only)

input_channels.accel: X[:, 6, :] (30 samples/epoch, standardized 1 Hz triaxial magnitude)

sliding_window_inference.long_night_rule: N > 1200: W=1200, stride=600, margin=300, boundary anchors w=0 and w=N-1200

verified_pooled_epoch_oof_3seed_summary.aggregation_note: Pooled across all valid epochs of all 47 subjects, reported as Mean +/- SD across N=3 seeds (distinct from unweighted N=47 participant-mean OOF reported in Stage 2/3 paired comparisons).

tier_0_zero_shot.description: Direct frozen population backbone inference with full-night L=1200 context.

tier_1_unsupervised_auxiliary.method: InfoMax entropy minimization with marginal diversity regularization (TSK-07 / DEC-036)

wearable_quality_gate.note: On cached z-scored IHR inputs (prep_57738d534b), enforces finite |z| <= 10.0; when raw_bpm_array or unstandardized BPM is supplied, enforces [30.0, 180.0] BPM.

verified_evidence.classification: SUB-BENCHMARK GAIN (Safe mild auxiliary; not a substitute for labeled calibration)

tier_2_supervised_calibration.method: Within-person supervised fine-tuning with RCC composite loss (TSK-06 / DEC-035)
tier_2_supervised_calibration.out_of_study_deployment_note: Within 5-fold CV, adapt_supervised selects the fold-locked Stage D config. For out-of-study deployment, use either the 5-fold backbone ensemble or consensus config (lr=3e-5, epochs=5, scope='all').

stage_coverage_safety_diagnostic.rationale: Flags severely missing-stage calibration nights (e.g., Bidslab34 with 0.68% Deep sleep) that risk catastrophic negative transfer.

verified_locked_exp019_ha_n46_e2.reconciled_verdict: INCONCLUSIVE (did not meet +1.50 pp practical threshold; substantial subject heterogeneity including negative transfer)

verified_evidence_common_cohort_n33_e4.dimension_1_verdict: REPLICATION CONFIRMED (van der Aar et al. 2025 3-night healthy-adult replication)
verified_evidence_common_cohort_n33_e4.dimension_2_verdict: INCONCLUSIVE SCALING (overall Page's L monotonic trend significant, but individual marginal steps beyond k=1 do not reach Holm-Bonferroni significance)
